# rspice-veriloga-models

The precompiled Verilog-A model catalog: Rust generated from the Verilog-A
sources under `models/veriloga/`, one Cargo package per model. Nothing in this
tree is written by hand. `rspice-veriloga-gen` emits every file, this README
included, and `manifest.txt` records the digests of the sources and of the
generator that produced them, so an edited or stale file fails verification
instead of compiling.

## What's in here

- `src/lib.rs` re-exports the `rspice-veriloga-runtime` ABI and every model
  whose feature is enabled.
- `src/registry.rs` is the registry `rspice-core` resolves a model through:
  each model's descriptor (terminals, parameters, node and branch counts,
  source identity) and the dispatch into its generated code.
- `models/<package>/` holds one generated package per model.
- `manifest.txt` records the source-tree and generator digests, and the size
  and BLAKE3 hash of every other file in this tree.

## Models

A deck never names this crate. It reaches a model by the model's name on an
`X` line, or through `rspice-core`'s model-card routing: a `.model` card that
names the model's type, or a `LEVEL` that `rspice-core` maps to it. Names are
compared without regard to case.

## Feature flags

| Flag | Effect |
| :--- | :--- |
| `veriloga-model-<name>` | Compiles in one model; the table above lists each one |
| `veriloga-builtins-noise` | Adds the generated noise schedules of every selected model |

A model compiles in only behind its own feature, so compile time, peak rustc
memory and binary size follow the models a build selects. `rspice-core`
forwards each of these flags under the same name, and its `veriloga-builtins`
feature selects every model together with noise.

## Regenerating

These files are never edited. From the repository root:

```bash
cargo run -p rspice-veriloga --profile generator --bin rspice-veriloga-gen -- regenerate-builtins
cargo run -p rspice-veriloga --bin rspice-veriloga-gen -- check-builtins
```

With any generated model enabled, `rspice-core`'s build script verifies this
tree against `manifest.txt` and fails on a missing, modified or untracked file.
[`rspice-veriloga`](../rspice-veriloga/README.md#generating-the-built-in-device-models)
documents the generator: subset generation, discovery markers and the digest
inputs.
